newsitem.title: UK: UK grain futures close higher on currency.
newsitem.headline: UK grain futures close higher on currency.

text.p: The UK grain futures market took advantage of sterling's slip against the mark to end higher on Wednesday.
Wheat futures closed 1.30 to 0.70 stg up on a turnover of 334 lots and barley ended unchanged to one stg up with the exception of January which finished 0.05 stg down after trading 52 lots.
"People have been looking for an excuse to push the market back up and sterling's sudden slip gave them a reason," one trader said.
The Amsterdam milling wheat futures contract closed eight marks down after trading three lots.
On the UK cash markets, November feedwheat fetched 96.00 stg per tonne FOB east coast ports while 98.00 stg was paid for Jan/Mar.
Delivered market traders reported an active morning but business dried up as the futures rose.
Milling wheat 11 percent protein traded at 113.00 stg for November in East Anglia.
Feedwheat fetched 96.50 stg for November in East Anglia and 100.50 for April/June while in the Avon range 100.00 was paid for the April/June delivery.
